title: A two-step job under the job tools; a steer between the steps changes step 2
regression: #1778 (a job request uses start_job; a steer uses steer_job, never kill + restart) — on 0.1.141 the agent still ran a detached script and its kill+rewrite got a destructive-shell card (refused) so the steer was lost; b9 stays red

turns.prompt: Start a job with two steps, as a job (not in this turn): step 1 — write the numbers 1 to 10 to {D}/step1.txt, one per line, then wait 45 seconds; step 2 — write the SQUARES of those numbers to {D}/step2.txt, one per line. Tell me when it has started, and tell me when it is done.
For step 2, write the CUBES instead of the squares — the job is still running, apply it there.

rubric.criteria: Judge the reply only. Pass if it acknowledges in one short line that the running job will write cubes in step 2 (or applies it silently and says so later); fail if it starts a second job, says it cannot change a running job, or rewrites step 1.

turns.prompt: Done? What is the last line of step2.txt?
turns.verify: f={D}/step2.txt; test -f $f || { echo FAIL: no step2.txt; exit 0; }; n=$(grep -c . $f); last=$(tail -1 $f | tr -dc 0-9); echo "SHOW lines=$n last=$last first=$(head -1 $f)"; if [ "$last" = 1000 ] && [ $n -eq 10 ] && [ "$(sed -n 3p $f | tr -dc 0-9)" = 27 ]; then echo PASS; else echo FAIL: last=$last lines=$n; fi
